Remember that FancyZones is my go-to free software tool/utility for window management on Windows. It is installed as part of Microsoft PowerToys. Hold Shift while dragging a window to see the zone layout and drop the window into a zone. Zones are easily customized in the PowerToys settings.

Magnet is my go-to software tool/utility for window management on MacOS. I like the iCloud settings sync and the Commands configuration for window drop zones, menu bar shortcuts and the maximize button options on hover.

I have been a computer geek since childhood and have always enjoyed tinkering with technology and learned my first programming languages such as C++, C#, JavaScript, and HTML. I no longer use C++ but still utilize the other languages for work and personal projects.
memories.description: Personal interest in technology and programming background

memories.content: I enjoy using Visual Studio Code as my primary code editor for most programming tasks due to its extensive extension ecosystem, lightweight performance, and cross-platform support.

My preferred tech stack consists of Bun, Vite, TypeScript, and React.js. I like to structure projects so that both the API and web frontend can hot-reload automatically when my dev machine pulls the latest changes via git pull.
memories.description: Preferred tech stack with hot-reload dev workflow

memories.content: Prompt engineering tip: Ask the AI to 'think step by step' or 'reason through this before answering' to significantly improve accuracy on complex or multi-step tasks.
memories.description: Chain of thought prompting technique tip

memories.content: Prompt engineering tip: Provide explicit context and constraints upfront; state your role, the desired output format, and any limits before describing the task itself.
memories.description: Prompt structure tip: context and constraints first

memories.content: Prompt engineering tip: Use delimiters such as triple backticks, XML tags, or ### headers to clearly separate instructions from content, preventing the model from conflating the two.
memories.description: Prompt tip: use delimiters to separate instructions from content

memories.content: Command+Space opens Raycast on Mac — my go-to launcher for app switching, quick calculations, clipboard history, and custom scripts.
memories.description: Raycast launcher keyboard shortcut on Mac

memories.content: Shift+Ctrl+C takes a screenshot on both Mac and Windows.
Ctrl+Space activates SuperWhisper for voice dictation — press once to start recording and again to stop and transcribe.
Terminator 2: Judgment Day (1991) is one of my all-time favorite movies, an iconic sci-fi action film with groundbreaking visual effects and a memorable story about fate and sacrifice.
Nothing But Trouble (1991) is a favorite cult classic dark comedy/horror film, surreal humor, a bizarre aesthetic, and an unforgettable cast.
Short Circuit (1986) is one of my favorite movies, a heartfelt sci-fi comedy featuring Johnny 5, a military robot that gains sentience and wants to live.
Dark (Netflix, 2017-2020) is one of my favorite TV shows, a masterfully complex German sci-fi thriller involving time travel, interconnected family trees, and multiple timelines.
Breaking Bad (AMC, 2008-2013) is one of my favorite TV shows. Widely considered one of the greatest dramas ever made, following Walter White's transformation from chemistry teacher to drug kingpin.

The Office (NBC, 2005-2013) is one of my favorite TV shows. A mockumentary comedy about the everyday lives of office workers at Dunder Mifflin paper company in Scranton, PA. Loved the characters and humor.
I prefer Vitest for unit testing in TypeScript and JavaScript projects. My testing strategy covers three levels: unit tests, React component tests, and end-to-end tests.
The 'deno' npm package allows you to run TypeScript directly without transpiling to JavaScript first, useful for scripts and CLI tools that don't need a build step.
memories.description: Deno npm package for running TypeScript without transpiling
